title: oxalis griffithii subsp. taimonii
intro: Oxalis griffithii subsp. taimonii, commonly known as the Griffith's wood sorrel, is a species of flowering plant in the wood sorrel family, native to China. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include health benefits such as treating fever, inflammation, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Griffith's wood sorrel include anti-inflammatory, antipyretic, and expectorant properties, making it effective in relieving coughs and colds. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and are used to treat various health conditions.
